coord_notes.kind: QLoRA-type recipe: LoRA on a frozen NVFP4 base, trained by GRPO/DAPO, with scheduled noise on the RMSNorm gains during training.

methods.categorical_reading: QeRL is QLoRA under another quantiser (NVFP4) and an RL loss. obstructions.reason: Different quantisers give different translates of the same cone: \(\kappa_{\rm NVFP4}\theta_0+\mathcal M_{\le r}\subseteq\kappa_{\rm NF4}\theta_0+\mathcal M_{\le r}\) forces \(\kappa_{\rm NVFP4}\theta_0=\kappa_{\rm NF4}\theta_0\). The two are related by a translation, a transport rather than an arrow.
\(\theta_0\notin\kappa\theta_0+\mathcal M_{\le r}\) unless \(\mathrm{rank}\,e\le r\) (Prop V.2(a)), and the translate lies inside \(\theta_0+\mathcal M_{\le r}\) only if \(e=0\).

coord_notes.covariance: The update is symmetric under a pairing of input and output coordinates (the identity for square layers, truncation for rectangular ones). The image transforms only under congruence pairs \((g,\lambda g^{-\top})\), and independent neuron permutations on the two sides break it: imposed structure \(\Pi\).

coord_notes.kind: A family over tokens: top-\(k\) softmax routing over \(E\) rank-\(r/E\) LoRA experts, on the frozen residual \(W_0-W_{\rm res}\).
coord_notes.shape: Input-dependent mixture: function-level.
coord_notes.base_point: The subtracted \(W_{\rm res}=\frac sE\sum_iB_0^iA_0^i\) cancels the experts only for uniform weights \(1/E\), which top-\(k\) routing (\(k<E\)) never produces. As for QLoRA with \(\operatorname{rank}e>r\), this is recorded as a defect rather than as unpointed.

Per token the weight is a point of LoRA\(_{2r}\) at \(\theta_0\): the routed experts plus the frozen \(-W_{\rm res}\).

The input gauge \(\prod_tGL_r\) does not cancel, though: it fixes the subspaces \(\mathrm{col}[B^{(1)}\cdots B^{(T)}]\) and \(\mathrm{row}[A^{(1)};\dots]\) but moves the singular bases inside them, rotating every core by a common \((O_B,O_A)\in O(Tr)^2\). Linear inner rules are unaffected; coordinatewise ones (TIES, DARE) are gauge-dependent.

methods.categorical_reading: Core Space is a joint frame fixing done on factors rather than on products: the projection \(\Delta W\mapsto U_B^\top\Delta WV_A\) is lossless on the span of all updates, so linear rules are exact. Its frames come from the stacked factors, so a coordinatewise rule in core coordinates is not a function of the adapters \(B^{(t)}A^{(t)}\) (Prop V.4(a)), whereas KnOTS takes its frame from the concatenated products.

arrows.note: With task arithmetic as the inner rule, Core Space and task arithmetic have the same coefficient family (the projection is lossless).

obstructions.reason: With TIES inside, trimming and sign election act in different coordinates (core frames from stacked factors, KnOTS's frame from concatenated updates), so the two merged lines differ.
